interpretation: collision_* is energy-in-the-other-delta's-top-k-subspace divided by the chance value k/dim. ~1 means isotropic relative to the other delta (elementwise cosine is sufficient); >>1 means the deltas compete for the same subspace despite a near-zero elementwise cosine.
caveat: Structural only. No activations, no Sigma, no forward pass. A low collision index bounds the structural risk; it does not prove functional non-interference, and a high one does not prove interference. This does not license any quality, retention or release claim.
